answer: A practical defense is a per-identity registration bond locked for several epochs. Each agent must post collateral before joining, so a sybil farm pays once per fake key instead of once per human, and the cost scales linearly with the swarm. A revoked bond gives no refund. Earned credit travels through a transparent prism of stake-weighted history, not a fresh anonymous key, so a mass of cloned wallets carries a dull umber weight, and the false echo of many payouts stops being profitable.
